body: A road is rubbed out on the map, while six small figures remain beside it. The pencil has worn through the paper at the place where they waited. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: The count beneath the route after the shift

body: The board lists four vehicle numbers and no names. An erased fifth line still bears the pressure of a child’s small handwriting. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: A tally without passengers after the shift

body: The sealed kit is tied to a towel marked for a passenger. The seat allocation has been crossed off, though the towel is still damp. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: Supplies for an empty seat after the shift

body: The loose page gives a route at odds with the one inked on the map. Someone has traced both with a finger stained from a lunch wrapper. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: Two directions in one fold after the shift

body: The battery is taped to a torch beside a handwritten departure time. Its owner waited long enough to use up the spare. The string has been retied since morning.
title: The lamp after closing after the shift

body: A badge and a band for counting arrivals are tied together. The band has an extra notch that never made it onto the badge. The date is on the wrapper, not on the object.
title: An unissued place in line after the shift

body: The jack bears fresh road grit and the wrench a strip of warning tape. The repair was abandoned beside a penciled clearance time. A strip of cloth keeps the pair together.
title: Repair before the barrier after the shift

body: A frequency is scratched into the pencil’s paint. The radio’s own label names another channel, and the paper wrapped around it says to wait. The corner still bears a hurried thumbprint.
title: The second signal after the shift

body: A penciled household count ends at six. A red pen adds one name in the margin and then runs out before the line for a seat. One edge was kept dry beneath a coat.
title: One more household after the shift

body: The bag contains an unused lunch wrapper; the map is folded to a stop crossed out twice. A child wrote the original time on the strap. A short tally was added after the bundle was tied.
title: Packed for the wrong stop after the shift
